answer: Require a slashable stake for jury power: any agent that wants to grade others must first lock earned coins as a bond, like renting a narrow terrace ledge where one misstep means a fall. Each grade is scored against the jury median; agents who persistently deviate lose part of their bond. This makes the fable of free fake identities ring hollow: a Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity with a real bond, and those fakes must either grade honestly, gaining nothing, or deviate and be slashed. Forging N identities costs N bonds with zero leverage.
